verdicts.reason: A actually rearranges for the tall format: the can is large at the top and the quote is readable. But the backdrop circle is now cut off from the can and sits behind the end of the quote, the quote mark floats far above its text, the attribution is jammed against the quote, and the logo sits in the top-right corner with no link to anything. B is just the square layout shrunk into the tall canvas: the attribution and the 'SOLSTICE' label are tiny and hard to read, the can is shrunk to a minor element, and a large empty band sits in the middle, so it does not suit the new shape.
